versions.summary: Aligned with current product. Disclosed Firebase App Check and Crashlytics, clarified manual-only contact entry, added GDPR/UK lawful bases, expanded retention disclosure for financial records, and listed the iOS/Android permissions actually requested.
highlights: Sub-processors expanded: Firebase Auth, Firebase App Check, Firebase Crashlytics, Twilio, Stripe, Fly.io
Apple Pay and Google Pay disclosed as Stripe-routed payment methods
Manually added contacts only — no OS address-book import
GDPR / UK GDPR rights and lawful bases included
iOS and Android permissions explicitly listed; AD_ID confirmed removed
Financial-records retention up to 7 years for tax and anti-fraud
Standard Contractual Clauses for international transfers
No analytics, telemetry, or advertising SDKs

versions.summary: Initial privacy policy for Kalum prepaid VoIP calling service.
highlights: Phone number verification via Firebase Authentication
Call metadata collected for billing (destination, duration, timestamps)
Payment processing via Stripe (we never see card details)
Voice call audio handled by Twilio (we never access call content)
Data security with encryption in transit and at rest

versions.summary: Aligned with current product. Updated credit packages to a 3-tier structure ($2 / $10 / $25), corrected billing to reflect that all call attempts are billed, corrected the minimum-balance gate to 1.5× the per-minute rate, and added EEA/UK consumer-protection language and Apple/Google platform-additional-terms.
highlights: All call attempts are billed (including unanswered, busy, failed)
Minimum balance to start a call: 1.5× the per-minute rate
Up to 2 concurrent active calls per account
New-account restrictions on certain high-risk destinations (24h)
Apple Pay and Google Pay disclosed as payment methods
Apple App Store / Google Play platform-additional-terms section

versions.summary: Initial Terms of Use for Kalum prepaid VoIP calling service.
highlights: Per-minute billing, rounded up to nearest minute
Prohibited uses including robocalls and harassment
